verdict.rationale: The CLI docs show `lms load openai/gpt-oss-20b --identifier="my-model-name"`, which assigns a custom identifier at load time. The server exposes OpenAI-like endpoints and a REST API, where that identifier would be the model reference. The evidence does not explicitly state that the identifier is what API requests use as the model name. Missing for 10: explicit docs tying the identifier to API model references, detail on identifier persistence and behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
